gate_text: Traceable primary source and exact source location
measured: source_ref 1959/1959; in-document locus 1959/1959, of which 1719 name a table/figure/supplement cell and 240 name a document section (prose-derived facts)
detail: Every row names both a retrievable source and a place inside it. The section-level loci are facts stated in prose rather than tabulated, so a section is their exact location; they are not missing loci. This gate passes on its own terms, which does not make the rows qualified - the other gates are where this endpoint fails.

gate_text: Sequence verified 5'->3', with strand identity and duplex partner where applicable
measured: sequence_5to3 present 200/259; strand_role column ABSENT; duplex_partner_id column ABSENT; double-stranded constructs 6
detail: Sequences are recorded and directional, but the two fields this gate names do not exist in the schema. For the double-stranded constructs the gate cannot be evaluated at all: nothing records which strand a sequence is, or what it pairs with. This is the clearest FAIL.

gate_text: Chemical modification encoded by position, not only as a molecule-level flag
measured: position-resolved modification_map 44/259; of those, source-verbatim 0; molecule-level flags only 194/259
detail: A minority carry a true per-position map. The majority carry molecule-level chemistry only, which is exactly what this gate excludes. Two maps were reverted this round because they had been composed from a related molecule's backbone rather than read from a source.

gate_text: Assay context includes cell system, donor information, delivery/formulation, dose and exposure time
measured: system_model 1959/1959; delivery_method 1950/1959; dose 1748/1959; exposure_duration 1839/1959; donor_id column ABSENT
detail: Dose and exposure are well covered; delivery/formulation is the weakest reported field and donor information has no column at all, so per-donor variation cannot be modelled or even counted. §B names donor/cell system as part of the unit of observation.

gate_text: Raw/continuous outcomes retained when available; curator-derived labels explicitly marked derived
measured: continuous readout_value retained 1589/1959; curator-assigned grades 1959; derived-label marker column ABSENT
detail: The continuous readout is retained alongside the label, which is the half of this gate that passes. The other half fails outright: no column states that thrombocytopenia_grade is curator-derived rather than source-reported, so a downstream reader cannot tell the two apart. All graded rows are referred to German as provisional.

gate_text: Agonist, antagonist, potentiator and inert/low-response states are separated
detail: effect_direction records which way a readout moved; it does not encode the four states this gate names. The gate is written for receptor pharmacology and generalizes here to separating an actively harmful construct from one measured and found inert. We cannot currently do that.

gate_text: Human and animal observations are not pooled as interchangeable ground truth
measured: separate views written True; human rows 1453; animal rows 497; assigned to neither (unresolved or multi-species) 9; pooled grade-difference column removed; bridge carries exposure_comparable + interpretation_limit True
detail: Human and animal evidence are split into separate views, the ranking that feeds the scientist is computed on human rows only, and the arithmetic difference between a human and an animal grade — which asserted the interchangeability this gate forbids — was deleted and replaced by per-side exposure plus an explicit interpretation limit. Pooled multi-species findings are assigned to neither side rather than forced onto one.

gate_text: Endpoint-specific outcomes are not collapsed into a composite (generalized from TLR7/8/9)
measured: distinct readout_name values 439; readout_category distribution {'platelet_count': 1083, 'clinical_outcome': 226, 'platelet_activation': 196, 'platelet_aggregation': 119, 'platelet_binding': 117, 'immunogenicity': 105, 'coagulation': 62, 'megakaryocyte': 26}; platelet-specific rows flagged 1734/1959
detail: The named readout survives on every row; the grade is a secondary derived field layered over it, not a replacement for it. is_platelet_specific keeps a true platelet readout separable from a general haematology or safety readout, so nothing is silently composited.

gate_text: Citation metadata and file identities pass QC
measured: sources in inventory 70; stable source_uid assigned True; QC gates in scripts/qc_thrombo.py: 5 governance + round-trip + backbone-consistency
detail: Colliding source ids were resolved to stable uids, 27 citation defects found by auditing my own search fleet's log were corrected (a fabricated title, three false 'searched' flags, a yield inferred rather than read, twenty cross-family duplicates), and QC runs on every build. Gate 9 is about whether citations pass QC, and they do now — they did not before the audit.

gate_text: Train/test splitting checked for exact-sequence, modified/unmodified counterpart, strand, family, paper and experimental-series leakage
measured: exact_sequence_group 259/259; scaffold_family 35/259; publication_group 35/259; matched_pair_id 4/259; strand grouping ABSENT; experimental-series grouping ABSENT; measured leakage cost random ~0.94 vs LOPO ~0.65
detail: Four of the six leakage axes have grouping keys and the cost of ignoring them is measured, not assumed. Strand leakage cannot be checked because gate 2's fields do not exist. Experimental-series leakage has no key; the study registry's 23 proved nesting edges are the nearest thing and do not cover it.

gate_text: LOPO and sequence-family grouped performance reported with uncertainty
measured: classifier release state BLOCKED; model trained this round: no
detail: No model is trained, so there is no performance to report. The gate becomes live the moment one is, and reporting a single number without LOPO and sequence-family grouping would fail it. The prior classifier was retracted rather than re-reported.

gate_text: All major mechanistic and clinical claims are no stronger than the evidence supports
measured: count ladder published with every rung and its loss reason; endpoint audit survivors 19/22; in-vitro rows whose grade derives from a clinical scale 523
detail: Three overstatements were corrected this round: a structure-activity result asserted as reproduced from curation when it describes provisional curator labels; a rights conclusion stated as lawful redistributability when it is a project classification; and a trial count quotable as qualified when it is only typed. PARTIAL not PASS because the corrections were needed at all — the recurring finding across endpoints is conclusions outrunning evidence, and this endpoint produced three instances in one document set.
